$Comment: The Magic Ruins kit, plug for its Magic_Ruins_Cave doors: vanilla's empty prefab Dungeon.Dungeon_Empty, which the painter fills with Rock_Stone over the whole Box.

Vanilla's graph Dungeons/Dungeon_Magic_Ruins ships no wall cap for this Kind: vanilla digs the kit into rock, so a doorway its graph leaves open runs into rock. The plug is that rock, a slab one block deep over the widest doorway of the Kind (57 doorways measured across every variant), the shape of the Stone kit's own Walls caps. Written by tools/rooms/import_kit.py; re-run the importer instead of editing this file.
As a Cap it carries, key by key, every tag value of the rooms whose doors it can close.
